description: Declarative PDF, contract, citation, page-span, redline, and privacy-aware document review workflow pack.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Document intelligence is an optional review overlay; defaultspack remains the runtime, grant, and tool-routing owner.
promotion_blockers: No runtime handlers or document parsers are owned by this pack.
Citation and redline quality requires real-world reviewer evidence.
Privacy review must remain explicit and opt-in before any broader default behavior.

conflict_notes: This pack declares owner boundaries and handoff policy instead of overriding runtime tools.
Scan and media analysis remain in rumi_multimodal_media_pack.
Sensitive document review may hand off to rumi_security_review_pack.
